items.title: XRP Ledger patched decade-old bug that could create billions of dollars in XRP from nothing
items.summary: Researchers demonstrated how a payment could create spendable XRP without the sender funding it, prompting an emergency software release.

items.title: Solana is about to halve its block times as final 200-millisecond upgrade nears
items.summary: The network is completing a seven-week push to produce blocks twice as frequently, though validators face higher costs and tighter operating windows.

items.title: Crypto projects apply for Anthropic’s new frontier AI security scanner
items.summary: Anthropic’s new opt-in service promises vulnerability reports from its strongest AI models, including Claude Mythos.

items.title: One year after 10/10 flash crash, bitcoin and ether liquidity have rebuilt, but altcoins still face risks
items.summary: Bitcoin and ether order books are deeper than before the crash, while altcoin liquidity keeps eroding and spot trading remains well below its October 2025 peak.

items.title: Bitcoin's $19 billion wake-up call: One-year after flash crash, has crypto learned anything?
items.summary: The Oct. 10, 2025 flash crash wiped out billions in leveraged crypto bets. Traders now have better tools to spot risks, but the forces behind the selloff remain.

items.title: Bitcoin's volatility has plunged, but extreme price swings are more frequent than in 2018
items.summary: CoinDesk analysis finds 10 unusually large trading days in 2026, raising questions about how investors measure risk in an increasingly institutional crypto market.

items.title: Tech chief says EU can fend off rogue AI risk: Report
items.summary: There are global concerns following incidents at OpenAI ‌and Anthropic, and fears have arisen that rogue AI agents may venture beyond human control.

items.title: Zcash developers set January target for quantum-resistant payments after ‘bunker mode’ scare
items.summary: The plan concerns public payments, where about seven in 10 ZEC sit. A separate wallet tool would keep balance checks from revealing which addresses belong together.

items.title: HSBC, Ant Digital test AI-agent payments using tokenized deposits
items.summary: The technical trial showed how AI agents could discover services and make micropayments using HSBC’s tokenized deposits, with real-time settlement and risk checks.

items.title: ESMA seeks evidence tokenized collateral can be cashed out in crisis
items.summary: ESMA is seeking industry feedback on the legal, liquidity and operational risks of tokenized collateral before deciding whether additional EU regulatory measures are necessary.

items.title: Trump administration outlines quantum, AI initiatives in $6B science push
items.summary: The White House outlined a $215 million quantum computing competition and $2.4 billion in AI industry commitments as concerns grow over quantum threats to cryptocurrency security.

items.title: IMF warns tokenized markets could amplify financial risks
items.summary: The global financial institution found tokenized equity markets less liquid and more volatile than traditional markets, despite growing demand for 24/7 trading.

items.title: SequenceHash: multihashing for the rest of us
items.summary: Multihashing is one of those cryptographic tasks that’s easy not to think about too much. This is unfortunate, because multihashing is a common stumbling point when cryptographers try to use hashes. As part of our goal to “fix software, not bugs,” Trail of Bits is introducing Seq

items.title: Tokenized commodities look beyond gold as lending and oil open new markets
items.summary: Paxos Labs, Theo and Energy Substantiation execs see growth coming from putting physical assets to work, with precious metals leading and energy presenting a tougher test.

items.title: Robinhood Chain slowdown spreads from fees to trading as transactions fall more than 40%
items.summary: Daily activity has dropped from 10.8 million transactions to 6.2 million since mid-September even as Robinhood keeps paying network fees on customer swaps.

items.title: Visa survey says nearly half of APAC consumers open to using stablecoins by 2031
items.summary: Visa’s survey of 14,250 people found interest in stablecoin payments is growing, though only 6% of respondents correctly understood how they work.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Justin Sun says Tron’s post-quantum cryptography has gone live on testnet
items.summary: “We’re ready to bring quantum resistance to mainnet at any time,” Sun said in a post on X.

items.title: Sam Altman-backed Bitcoin life insurer, Meanwhile, raises more funds
items.summary: The round follows increased international demand for Meanwhile’s Bitcoin life insurance policies amid broader macro instability.

items.title: U.S. CFTC moves to fold event contracts into swaps regulations as legal fight rages
items.summary: The derivatives regulator is proposing a formal rule to include certain contracts traded on platforms like Kalshi's as swaps that require the agency's oversight.
